providers.name: Azure OpenAI (Microsoft Foundry)
providers.note: Azure OpenAI models only, shown as model@version. Azure sets a retirement date at launch, so active models carry one. Rows whose date has passed without a Retired lifecycle are left out. Schedules differ from OpenAI's own API.

providers.name: Google Vertex AI
providers.note: "or later" and "no sooner than" dates are shown as earliest-possible. Models whose listed date has passed while the page still shows them as available are left out until the page is clear.
